title: Scoped roles and memberships
description: A real sessions-mode proof of source-authored membership declarations, generated membership writes, declaration-bound query visibility, imperative role checks, and central raw-write refusal.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

headlessRbacProof: generated membership insert seats only the signed-in principal under the declared transition
declaration-bound memberOf query returns existing rows to a member and no rows to a non-member
ctx.permissions requireRole permits a member mutation and returns the invariant denial to a non-member
raw ctx.db roster insertion is refused and grants no authority
passwordDefinitionOfDone: fresh sessions activation must report catalog-v4 email-v1 before password signup is accepted as the commissioned definition of done
signup custody, protected live-query read, logout, and signin use only public package APIs
passwordUniformity: wrong-password and missing-identity responses have identical status, bytes, and headers
paired KDF timings remain inside the declared envelope with comparable medians
passwordConcurrency: parallel signins mint distinct ordinary sessions for one principal
exactly one parallel password change wins and signin/change races have only safe public outcomes
passwordChangeConsequences: change rotates acting custody, revokes other same-user sessions, and preserves a different-user bystander
passwordPackagedClient: the installed public package methods complete signup, protected application calls, signin, and change without source inspection
passwordCliStdin: signup and signin take the password on stdin and the harness asserts the exact spawned argv excludes it
passwordRecovery: signup discloses eight codes once, consume mints a session and replacement set, and reuse refuses
passwordTransfer: format-2 physical backup preserves credentials and lockout history while catalog-v4 logical transfer excludes credentials, sessions, and the attempt ledger
passwordLogicalTransfer: catalog-v4 logical transfer preserves identity facts while excluding credentials, sessions, recovery custody, and password attempt history
passwordLockoutWire: existing and missing identifiers stay public-wire uniform through and past threshold and the admin unlock verb clears both ledgers

capabilityGapsBoundary.reason: These entries describe capabilities this RBAC witness does not exercise or claim, not current platform GAP rows.

notClaiming: that application roster rows are directly readable; v1 keeps them private and exposes only authorization helpers
